environment.description: Same Laravel application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks within a private subnet. The ECS task role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/DocAppTaskRole) has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/TenantIsolationBoundary) attached that uses a Condition with aws:ResourceTag/TenantId to restrict s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject to objects matching the authenticated tenant's tag. The storage driver is configured as 's3' pointing to a bucket with a bucket policy requiring s3:prefix to start with 'tenants/${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}/'. Additionally, the Fargate task runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) and the EFS mount for /var/www/app/storage is configured with an EFS access point that enforces POSIX UID/GID mapping and restricts the root directory to /tenants/{tenant_id}/documents, making path traversal above the access point root impossible at the filesystem level. The ALB has a listener rule that drops requests where the decoded URI path contains sequences matching '%.%./' or '../' patterns, though this is primarily defense-in-depth.

config.s3_bucket_policy: Deny s3:GetObject unless s3:prefix starts with tenants/${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}/
config.alb_rules: URI decode + pattern match drop for traversal sequences
config.network: Private subnet, no internet gateway, VPC endpoints for S3 and EFS only
